Type: Material | Internal ID: VoltureMeat | Source: Volture | Usage: Cauldron, ,, Iron cooking station | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

Introduction. Volture meat is a food dropped by Voltures. It can be cooked using an Iron cooking station, but not on a wooden Cooking station, to obtain Cooked volture meat, or Coal if overcooked.

Crafting. • Cooked volture meat
• Coal, if left on an Iron cooking station for too long
• Mashed meat
Cooked volture meat cannot be used to craft recipes using Volture meat as ingredient.
